(2020) measures information.docx' section 2.2.7.6 'Behaviour change to reduce individual risk of contracting COVID-19'.
note: Item codes Protect1..Protect11 ARE the .sav column names W1_Protect1..11 with the W1_ prefix stripped by data/c19prc_uk_mcbride_2021_build.py (crosswalk key protect, waves=[1]; no rename, no positional step, no reverse-coding; recode 'protect' only drops resp 5). Variable labels read 'To protect yourself from COVID-19, to what degree have you changed your plans and behaviour to avoid the following? - <item>'; the question went to instructions and the text after ' - ' to item_text, 11/11 identical to the W1 questionnaire grid rows (Q86) and the codebook. option_text = .sav value labels 1-4 verbatim, including the misspelling 'occassionally' in 'Avoided to a small degree/occassionally', which is also what the administered questionnaire printed (Q86 column header 'Avoided to a small degree/ occassionally (3)'); the codebook spells it 'occasionally' and the measures document paraphrases 4 as 'Avoided completely'. Kept the administered spelling. The questionnaire header adds a space after the slash and a full stop after 'quite often'; the .sav label form was shipped. Value 5 'Not applicable to me (I had no plans to do this)' is dropped by the build script as missing and so has no row (it is not in the live resp set). Cross-check (not required for data_labels): .sav W1 item x resp counts for 1-4 match the live table cell-for-cell, 44/44 (e.g. Protect1 219/52/111/388, Protect8 256/558/803/344); live 15132 rows, 1996 ids, all wave 1. Sibling c19prc_uk_mcbride_2021_protective_behaviours is a different instrument (Hygiene_1..13, W5/W6) and was not touched. Step 3b: live items match the named block (W1 avoidance behaviour change, 11 items, 1-4). Rights: study-authored items (measures document cites no source instrument); no fee/permission/NC/ND/redistribution clause located -- shipped on silence under the CC BY 4.0 deposit, no register row written. English administration (UK), so no language/_translated columns.
public_note: Responses of 'Not applicable to me (I had no plans to do this)' were removed from the response data, so each item's n reflects only respondents who had plans to do the activity (from 770 for travelling to infected areas to 1,961 for touching eyes or mouth).

note: Item codes Hygiene_1..13 ARE the .sav column names W5_Hygiene_N / W6_Hygiene_N with the wave prefix stripped by data/c19prc_uk_mcbride_2021_build.py (crosswalk key protective_behaviours, waves [5,6]; no rename dict, no positional step, no recode or reverse-coding). The .sav variable labels read '<stem> - <behaviour>'; the stem went to instructions and the behaviour to item_text verbatim (en dash in item 1 '–e.g.' and 'Sanitized'/'sanitising' spellings kept as in the source), 13/13 identical to the W5 questionnaire grid rows. WAVE DIFFERENCES: (a) the stem: W5 'To reduce your risk of being infected by COVID-19, in the past week, how often have you:'; W6 'To reduce your risk of being infected by COVID-19 or to reduce the spread of COVID-19 in the community, in the past week, how often have you:' (W6 .sav label carries a double space before 'in the past week'; both W6 questionnaires single-spaced); (b) item 12: W5 'Stayed at least 2 metres (6ft) away from others when in public?', W6 'Stayed at least 1 metre (3ft) away from others when in public?' (W6 labels and both W6 questionnaires; W6 supplementary doc misprints '1 metres'). Items 1-11 and 13 are byte-identical across W5 and W6 labels. Because codes pool both waves, one wording is needed: shipped the W5 wording throughout (W5 = 2520 of 4578 responses per item; W6 = 2058), following the batch_715 hygiene / batch_722 phq9 precedent, and disclosed the W6 variants in public_note. The distance change tracks the UK's move from 2m to '1m plus' guidance; same behaviour, different threshold, so treated as a wording variant rather than the batch_718 lockdown_contact_behaviours defect (different questions under one code). option_text = .sav value labels 1=Never, 2=Occasionally, 3=Whenever possible, identical for all 26 W5/W6 variables and matching all three questionnaire grid headers (W5 supplementary doc's 'no, occasionally' is a doc typo; its own range sentence says 1 'Never'). Cross-check (not required for data_labels): .sav per-wave x item x resp counts match the live table cell-for-cell, 78/78 (e.g. W5 Hygiene_1 107/128/2285, W6 Hygiene_1 231/475/1352, W6 Hygiene_12 158/601/1299); live 59514 rows, 3155 ids, W5 32760 rows, W6 26754. Step 3b: dictionary Description 'COVID-19 protective behaviours (face covering, distancing, hygiene)' matches the items; the study labels the block 'Hygiene practices'. This is NOT the W1/W2 COM-B 'Hygiene1..18' determinants block (c19prc_uk_mcbride_2021_hygiene) nor the W1 'Protect1..11' avoidance block (sibling c19prc_uk_mcbride_2021_protect); crosswalk says so explicitly. Rights: study-team items, no register row, no fee/permission/NC/ND/redistribution clause located -- silence, shipped from the study's own CC BY 4.0 deposit. English administration (UK), no language/_translated columns.
public_note: Items pool waves 5 and 6 and the shipped wording is wave 5's; at wave 6 the stem read 'To reduce your risk of being infected by COVID-19 or to reduce the spread of COVID-19 in the community, in the past week, how often have you:' and Hygiene_12 read 'Stayed at least 1 metre (3ft) away' instead of '2 metres (6ft)', so Hygiene_12 responses (2058 of 4578) at wave 6 refer to a 1-metre threshold.
